title: OppFi Reports Record Quarterly Revenue, Net Income, and Adjusted Net Income and Increases Full Year Guidance
summary: Net income increased 136.9% year over year to $75.9 million, a Company record for any quarter Adjusted net income 1 increased 41.4% year over year to $40.7 million, a Company record for any quarter Total revenue increased 13.5% year over year to $155.1 million, a Company record for any quarter Raised full year revenue guidance to between $590 million and $605 million, adjusted net income 1 to between $137 million and $142 million, and adjusted EPS to between $1.54 and $1.60 OppFi Inc. (NYSE: OPFI) ("OppFi" or the "Company"), a tech-enabled digital finance platform that partners with banks to offer financial products and services to everyday Americans, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025. "OppFi continued to deliver strong performance in the third quarter 2025, achieving record quarterly revenue, profit and net originations.
